entry.title: Resolution 469 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES AND DIRECTS THE DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC WORKS TO ISSUE A LICENSE FOR ENTRY, LANDSCAPING, AND MAINTENANCE OF A PORTION OF A RIGHT-OF-WAY OWNED BY THE COUNTY

Seeks to grant Kuakini Makai Association, Inc., a revocable license to enter, landscape, and maintain a portion of Kuakini Highway.

Status: — → Adopted
